book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MATEO

content: Yechel yin̈ huntekꞌan ebnaj munlawom
Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús tet ebnaj iscuywom: —Anma chioc yul iskꞌab Comam Dios lahan hacaꞌ hunu naj yahaw munil to yin̈ caw sahab sacꞌayal issayaꞌ iscꞌamteꞌ chimunla xol teꞌ uva.
Hayet yilcha huntekꞌan ebnaj yu naj, yalni naj tato huneꞌ denario chakꞌ naj yin̈ tzꞌayic tet hunun ebnaj, lahwi tuꞌ isto ebnaj munlaho xol yuva naj.
Yin̈mi chꞌen balon̈eb yin̈ yet yalan̈ chuman isto naj yul txon̈bal, yilni naj huntekꞌanxa ebnaj mach ismunil.
Yalni naj tet ebnaj: “Ay munil incꞌatan̈an, chexintohlahan hacaꞌticꞌa caw yehi,” ẍi naj. Istopaxo ebnaj munil xol yuva naj.
Naj yahaw munil tuꞌ elpaxto naj yin̈ chumanil, yeb yin̈ chꞌen oxeb, hacticꞌapax tuꞌ yute yalni naj tet huntekꞌanxa ebnaj ilcha yu.
Yin̈xa chꞌen howeb xin, istopaxo naj txon̈bal hunelxa, yilni naj huntekꞌan ebnaj chiecꞌ bey tuꞌ mach ismunil. Iskꞌamben naj tet ebnaj: “¿Tzet yin̈ xin ton̈e chiecꞌ tzꞌayic teyiban̈ bey tiꞌ?” ẍi naj.

Istakꞌwi ebnaj: “Mamin, to machi mac chiakꞌni yet comunilan̈,” ẍi ebnaj. Yalni naj tet ebnaj: “Ta chisje hecꞌul asiꞌwe munil wintajan, chexintohlahan hacaꞌ caw yehi,” ẍi naj. Isto ebnaj munil yinta naj.

Haxa yin̈ kꞌejbiyal xin, yalni naj yahaw munil tuꞌ tet naj chiilni ismunil hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Awte sunil ebnaj munlawom cat hatohlan ebnaj. Ebnaj maoc munil yin̈ islahobal, haꞌ ebnaj chatohla babel. Wal ebnaj caw sahab maichico ismunla xin, islahobal chatohla ebnaj,” ẍi naj yahaw munil tuꞌ.
Lahwi tuꞌ xin yawtelax ebnaj oc munil yin̈ chꞌen howeb, haꞌ ebnaj babel tohlalaxi, huneꞌ denario akꞌlax tet hunun ebnaj.
Haxa yet yawtelax ebnaj ichico munil yin̈ caw sahab sacꞌayal, ham yalni ebnaj tato ecꞌbal istohol ebnaj chiakꞌlaxi, yajaꞌ machoj, huneꞌn̈e denario akꞌlaxpaxo tet hunun ebnaj.
Hayet ischahni ebnaj istohol tuꞌ yichico ebnaj isbuchwa yin̈ naj yahaw munil tuꞌ,

yalni ebnaj: “Ebnaj mahul yet islahobalxa tiꞌ hunxan̈e hora mamunla ebnaj, ¿tzet yin̈ xin lahan cotoholan̈ maxawakꞌ yeb ebnaj? Han̈on̈tiꞌan̈ ecꞌbal macon̈munlahan̈, yeb xin caw majakꞌ janmahan̈ xol kꞌaꞌ,” ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi naj yahaw munil tuꞌ tet huneꞌ naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Hach wet anmahil, mach chinetlihan tawin̈ yuto majala tato huneꞌ denario chintohlahan hatzꞌayic.
Wal xin mawakꞌan hatohol, paxan̈toj. Ta chiwochehan ta lahan chikꞌ ebnaj lan̈oxa maoc munil yebex, mach hawoc yin̈ huneꞌ tuꞌ.
Hanintiꞌan chu wakꞌnihan inmelyuhan tet mac bay chiwochehan, ¿mato chichiwa hacꞌul yu cꞌul incꞌulan?” ẍi naj yahaw munil tuꞌ.
Yuxin haꞌ mac babel tinan̈, haꞌ chicancano yin̈ islahobal, wal mac islahobal ye tinan̈, haꞌ chioc yin̈ babel. Hantan̈e mac awtebil yu Comam Dios, yajaꞌ haywan̈n̈e mac sicꞌbililoj, ẍi Comam.
Yal Comam Jesús iscamical yin̈ yoxel
Yet ayxaco Comam Jesús yeb anma yin̈ isbel bey Jerusalén, yawtenilo Comam ebnaj cablahon̈wan̈ iscuywom, yalni Comam tet ebnaj:

—Tinan̈ xin lan̈an coto bey Jerusalén, yajaꞌ Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios, chinálaxicojan yul iskꞌab ebnaj yahawil yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote yeb ebnaj cuywawom yin̈ isley naj Moisés cat iskꞌanni ebnaj camical wiban̈an.

Chilahwi tuꞌ cat quinyanicojan ebnaj yul iskꞌab ebnaj mach Israeloj, cat isbuchwa ebnaj win̈an, cat quinismakꞌnihan ebnaj. Chilahwi tuꞌ cat quinyanican̈an ebnaj yin̈ teꞌ culus, yajaꞌ yin̈ yox tzꞌayic cat witzitzbican̈an hunelxa, ẍi Comam.
Yin̈ tzet iskꞌan ismiꞌ naj Jacobo yeb naj Juan
Yet huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ apni ismiꞌ ebnaj iscꞌahol icham Zebedeo ilwal yin̈ Comam Jesús. Tzujan xin ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ yinta ismiꞌ, yay jahno ixnam sata Comam yuto ay huneꞌ tzet choche ixnam iskꞌanaꞌ.

Iskꞌamben Comam tet ixnam: —Miyay, ¿tzet chawoche hakꞌanaꞌ wetan? ẍi Comam. Istakꞌwi ixnam: —Mamin, yet chachoc Yahawoj chinkꞌanan tawet tato cawan̈ wunintiꞌan chioc tacꞌatan̈. Hunu naj chioc tzꞌon̈no yin̈ hawatxꞌkꞌab, hunuxa naj chioc tzꞌon̈no yin̈ hameckꞌab, ẍi ixnam.
Istakꞌwi Comam: —Hex tiꞌ mach heyohtajo tzet chekꞌana. ¿Chimyu heyucꞌni huneꞌ vaso ha haꞌ caw cꞌah
hacaꞌ huneꞌ chiwucꞌan? ẍi Comam. Istakꞌwi ebnaj: —Hoꞌ, chu jucꞌnihan̈, ẍi ebnaj.

Yalni Comam tet ebnaj xin: —Yeltoni chu heyucꞌni huneꞌ vaso ha haꞌ caw cꞌah chiwaltiꞌan, yajaꞌ wal hanintiꞌan mach wetojan walnihan mac chiay tzꞌon̈no yin̈ inwatxꞌkꞌaban yeb yin̈ inmeckꞌaban, to han̈e Inmaman ohtan̈e mac tet chakꞌa, ẍi Comam.
Hayet yaben ebnaj lahon̈wan̈xa iscuywom Comam, caw tit ishowal ebnaj yin̈ ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ.

Yet yilni Comam huneꞌ tuꞌ, yawtenico Comam ebnaj iscꞌatan̈, yalni Comam: —Hex tiꞌ caw heyohtaj tato ebnaj ayco yahawo con̈ob, ay yip ebnaj yiban̈ con̈ob tuꞌ. Haxa ebnaj nime winaj yul con̈ob yahawxa chute isba ebnaj yin̈ anma.
Wal texol xin mach cꞌuluj tato hac tuꞌ cheyute, wal xin ta ay hunu mac ecꞌbal yelapno ye chabe, ahojab chioc chejaboj.
Haxa mac choche ecꞌbal yelapno chuco texol xin, yakꞌabico isba chejaboj.

Hac tuꞌ wehan Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios, mach hulnajojinan yu inchejnihan anma, walxinto hacaꞌ chejab wecojan xol anma, cat wakꞌni camo inbahan hac tuꞌ xin chu intohlanan ismul txꞌiꞌal anma, ẍi Comam.
Yakꞌ hajlo Comam Jesús isbakꞌsat cawan̈ ebnaj mach chu yilni
Hayet yel Comam Jesús yeb ebnaj iscuywom yul con̈ob Jericó, caw hantan̈e anma oc tzujno yinta Comam.

Ay xin cawan̈ ebnaj mach chu yilni, tzꞌon̈anayo istiꞌ beh. Hayet yaben ebnaj tato haꞌ Comam Jesús lan̈an yecꞌtoj, yahwi ebnaj tet Comam yin̈ caw ip hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Mamin, yuninal iscꞌahol naj rey David, caw tzꞌayojab hacꞌul jin̈an̈, ẍi ebnaj.
Yajaꞌ xin oc anma iscachaꞌ ebnaj yun̈e isbejni ebnaj yel yaw, yaj caw islahico ebnaj yahwi, yalnipaxo ebnaj: —Mamin, iscꞌahol jichmam David, caw tzꞌayojab hacꞌul jin̈an̈, ẍi ebnaj.
Yet yaben Comam Jesús huneꞌ tuꞌ yoc lin̈noj, yawtenti Comam ebnaj iscꞌatan̈, iskꞌamben Comam tet ebnaj: —¿Tzet cheyoche chinwatxꞌehan? ẍi Comam.
Istakꞌwi ebnaj: —Mamin, chijochehan̈ chawakꞌ hajlo cosatan̈, ẍi ebnaj.
Istzꞌaycan̈ iscꞌul Comam yin̈ ebnaj; yanico Comam iskꞌab yin̈ isbakꞌsat ebnaj, yin̈n̈ena tuꞌ xin ishajlo issat ebnaj, yoc tzujno ebnaj yinta Comam.

footnotes.text: Huneꞌ vaso cꞌahla haꞌ chitzotel yin̈ isyaꞌtajil chihul yiban̈ Comam
